data.one_liner: Android plugin to retrieve Wi-Fi and network information
data.what_it_does: Retrieves network details such as IP address, router IP, DNS, BSSID, SSID, MAC address, link speed, signal strength, and frequency on Android devices using native code.
use_when: You need to read Wi-Fi network information on Android
You are maintaining an app that relies on legacy wifi_info_plugin
avoid_when: You are starting a new project, as the author states the package has no more usage beyond gradle updates
strengths: Simple API to access Android network details
weaknesses: Explicitly stated by the author to have no more active usage beyond gradle updates
